correctness.rationale: Dias--Koenig Theorems 5.4 and 5.6 reduce every positive-parity four-mode pure state, up to Gaussian unitary, to the vacuum/full-occupancy family with parameter equal to fermionic Gaussian fidelity. Substitution into Hoshino--Matsuda--Ashida Eq. (S90) at four modes gives the claimed polynomial exactly. The one-variable derivative is strictly negative on the allowed invariant interval, giving the unique fidelity value for equality. A direct two-copy Majorana implementation independently reproduces the polynomial at representative parameters.
